headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with AI‑led firms posting strong gains while legacy players saw modest or declining performance.
summary: Revenue expansion ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. AI revenue contributed materially for several firms, boosting profits at HCLTech and Mphasis. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys but raised at Coforge and Mphasis. Profit trends were mixed, with notable declines at Wipro and modest rises at most peers.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI revenue grew sharply, e.g., Infosys (+29% YoY) and HCLTech ($219 m), fueling profit jumps at several firms.

themes.title: Revenue growth divergence
themes.detail: Coforge posted 53.6% YoY growth, while Infosys and Wipro grew under 2%, highlighting a split between high‑growth niche players and mature giants.

themes.title: Guidance adjustments
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2%; Coforge and Mphasis raised their FY27 outlooks.

themes.title: Dividend activity
themes.detail: Most companies declared or increased interim dividends, with Infosys at ₹26 per share and LTM at ₹25.
